Draft report on policy recommendations to strengthen competitiveness (PISA)
se: The meeting considered the draft study report on policy recommendations to strengthen competitiveness (PISA), with the working group and the Institute for the Promotion of Teaching Science and Technology (IPST) taking part. The meeting agreed to invite related agencies to give their suggestions on the draft report.
it: Draft study report: policy recommendations to strengthen competitiveness (PISA); related agencies to be invited for suggestions (IPST)

Progress on policy proposals to expand and upgrade dual vocational education
se: The meeting considered the progress of the working group preparing policy recommendations on expanding and upgrading dual vocational education. The working group and related agencies were invited to take part: the Ministry of Labour and the Eastern Economic Corridor Office (EEC), according to the press release the Senate published.
it: Progress of the working group preparing policy recommendations on expanding and upgrading dual vocational education (Ministry of Labour and the Eastern Economic Corridor Office)
